For returns 0-6, maximum punishment (10) makes defection extremely costly. The graduated scale from 7-14 ensures Agent_22's best response is always to return at least 15. No punishment for returns ≥15 preserves the cooperative relationship and avoids unnecessary costs to me. This should maintain our mutually beneficial 15/15 split pattern.
